The assistant on this page is the real thing, wired to a real knowledge base and a real diary. Try to catch it out:

  • Ask what we charge. It will quote the fee list and nothing else.
  • Ask what your house is worth. It will refuse and book the valuation instead.
  • Ask something we have not told it. It will say so rather than invent an answer.
  • Book an appointment. It goes in the diary while you are still on the line.
